title: Quiz — 11.3 & 11.4 Shapes of Distributions and Two-Way Tables

questions.prompt: A histogram has a longer tail on the left and most of the data on the right. What is the shape?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: A longer left tail means the distribution is skewed left.

questions.prompt: For a symmetric distribution, the best measure of center is the ___.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Use the mean for symmetric data.

questions.prompt: For a skewed distribution, which measure of center should you use?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Use the median for skewed data.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the rule that states about 68% of data lie within 1 standard deviation of the mean for bell‑shaped data?
A bell‑shaped distribution has mean 50 and standard deviation 5. About what percent of data lie between 45 and 55?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: About 68% of data lie within 1 SD of the mean.

questions.prompt: In a skewed right distribution, the mean is usually ___ than the median.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The mean is greater than the median in a skewed right distribution.

questions.prompt: If a histogram has bars of about the same height, the distribution is called ___.
For a symmetric distribution, which measure of spread is best?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Standard deviation is the best measure of spread for symmetric data.

questions.prompt: The five‑number summary consists of minimum, Q1, median, Q3, and ___.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The five‑number summary ends with the maximum.

questions.prompt: For bell‑shaped data, a value more than 2 standard deviations from the mean is considered ___.
In a two-way table, the numbers inside the table are called:
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The numbers inside the table are joint frequencies.

questions.prompt: The sums of the rows and columns in a two-way table are called ___ frequencies.
A survey of 152 students about mobile access shows 55 freshmen say yes and 22 say no. How many freshmen were surveyed?
A two-way table has row totals of 60 and 40. What is the grand total?
What is a joint relative frequency?
options: A joint frequency divided by a row total
A joint frequency divided by the grand total
A marginal frequency divided by the grand total
A row total divided by a column total
questions.feedbackIfWrong: A joint relative frequency is a joint frequency divided by the grand total.

questions.prompt: To find a conditional relative frequency, divide a joint frequency by a ___ frequency (row or column total).

In a survey, 40 students play a sport and an instrument, 50 play a sport but no instrument, and the grand total is 200. What is the joint relative frequency of students who play a sport and an instrument? (Type as a simplified fraction, e.g., 1/5)
A two-way table shows that 70% of exercisers eat healthy, while only 20% of non‑exercisers eat healthy. This suggests:
options: No association between exercise and diet
An association between exercise and diet
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The large difference suggests an association between exercise and diet.

questions.prompt: If conditional relative frequencies are nearly identical across groups, there is ___ association between the variables.

A survey of 100 people: 60 are male, 40 are female. 30 males and 10 females prefer action movies. What is the conditional relative frequency of preferring action movies given male? (Type as a simplified fraction, e.g., 1/2)
